meta.description: What to do before your ADA exam, what to bring, and what happens on the day and after it.

title: Exam day and ID requirements
lead: What to do before your ADA exam, what to bring, and what happens on the day and after it.
scope: For the ADA Postpartum Doula exam.

before.title: Before exam day
before.registerValue: Register through your training provider, or with ADA directly at <mail>{email}</mail> or <tel>{phone}</tel>.
before.dateNoSession: Exam sessions are scheduled after each training cohort. <link>Exam dates</link>
before.languageValue: Choose {languages} when you register. All exam materials are provided in the language you choose.

onTheDay.title: On exam day
onTheDay.imageAlt: A candidate bathes a training doll in the practical exam while an examiner watches, with a timer on the screen behind
onTheDay.caption: A practical exam, with the timer on the screen. August 2024.
onTheDay.practicalValue: {minutes} minutes, one-on-one with an ADA examiner.

after.title: After the exam
after.resultsValue: By email in about {days} business days.
after.scoreValue: A score out of {max} and a level: Highly Proficient ({high} and above), Proficient ({pass}–{highBelow}) or Not Proficient (below {pass}). The pass mark is {pass}/{max}.
after.passValue: ADA issues your certificate, valid for {years, plural, one {# year} other {# years}}, and publishes your record in the ADA registry. <link>Check the registry</link>
after.failValue: You can register for a later date, {days} days or more after your attempt. The retake fee is {fee}. <link>Exam dates</link>

cta.title: Write to ADA with any question about your exam.
